n-gta6-dacity-coin.title: GTA 6 Dacity Coin coins
n-gta6-dacity-coin.summary: Coins named for Dacity Coin, an in-game meme coin that posts say appears in GTA 6 material. On 2026-10-11 the account @robtmb1 (RobTheMaster) posted that there is a meme coin in GTA 6 called "Dacity Coin" in a new leak (e4:0); the first Dacity Coin on pump.fun was created 35 seconds later (token created 2026-10-11 11:16 UTC, post at 11:15 UTC). A post of 2026-10-19 from the GTA 6 Intel account says DacityCoin appears on a stunt plane in GTA VI's launch trailer, a fictional crypto brand parodying real meme coins (e4:1). An automated claim check rated the claim "partly real" on 2026-10-18, saying the Dacity Coin name in GTA 6 material is real and widely reported but the leak timestamp and the leak's authenticity were not verified, and an earlier check on 2026-10-15 called it unclear (e4:0). Four coins carry the name: Dacity Coin (pump.fun, Solana; token created 2026-10-11), AudaCity (pump.fun; token created 2026-10-15 13:22 UTC), Dacity Coin (Pons, Robinhood Chain; created 2026-10-19 16:13 UTC) and GTAVI AudaCity (pump.fun; created 2026-10-20 04:04 UTC), whose metadata repeats the claim: "There's a meme coin in GTA 6 called \"Dacity Coin\" in the new leak." The other three have empty metadata, so their names carry the claim. Most posts about the coins are call-group promotion and listing-vote spam, and none of the coins is shown to be affiliated with Rockstar, Take-Two or the leak. These are traders' and the coins' own claims. Measured: four coins across all their pools.

summaries.n-perpetual-futures: Coins whose metadata describes perpetual-futures trading. Papertrade's site (papertrade.xyz, e1:1) says "1000x leverage, 0 market impact, 100% user owned, fully onchain on hyperliquid", and @papertrade_xyz posted that trading was expected to start at 14:00 UTC on 2026-10-10. Three coins named Paper (Papertrade) copy its tagline: a new Clanker contract on Base (pool created 2026-10-19 12:39 UTC) that carries 99.5% of the narrative's volume, and the two Clanker contracts that carried it a day earlier (Base, pool created 2026-10-18, and Robinhood Chain, pool created 2026-10-19), which traded about $1.4K and $0.9K in the last 24 hours after tens of millions the day before. Two older Paper contracts (Base and Robinhood Chain, pools created 2026-10-17) left on 2026-10-20 after their 24h pool volume stayed under $1,000. The sources seen never name any of these contracts. Posts of 2026-10-17 to 2026-10-19 say PAPER is trading as a pre-launch perpetual on Hyperliquid listed by Paragon and that the token cannot yet be moved between wallets (e1:7), so affiliation of the on-chain Paper copies with Papertrade is not verified. EmpireX (EMPIREX, Pons, Robinhood Chain) says it is a perpetual trading hub powered by Hyperliquid, and @HyperEmpireX introduced it on 2026-10-16. Purps (PURPS, Meteora DBC) says it launches perp-backed tokens. Aloooong (pump.fun) calls itself the "First 10x PUMP long perpetual meme". These are the projects' and traders' own claims: revenue, leverage, payouts and affiliation among the coins are not verified. Measured: six coins across all their pools.
summaries.n-super-intelligence: On Sept. 29 Trump said AI would officially be renamed "Super Intelligence" (Fox News). On 2026-10-04 the official @WhiteHouse account posted an announcement of a "Super Intelligence Force (SIF)", and Watcher.Guru and an @wallstreetbets post reported Elon Musk saying SpaceXAI will be renamed SpaceXSI; a 2026-10-15 post reports that the task force is due to hold its first meeting (e1:5). Super Inu ($SI), launched Sept. 21, re-pitched itself around the term; other coins followed, including another SI on pump.fun, 四 ("four", read as SI) on four.meme, Super Intelligence Force (SIF), Superintelligence Owl, two SpaceXSI coins on StonkFun, SpaceX Inu ($SI on Flap), Act II: The SI Prophecy, and three BNB Chain coins on Flap named TeslaSI ("Tesla Super Intelligence", pool created 2026-10-11; a second whose Chinese metadata says it follows the SpaceXAI to SpaceXSI rename; and, since 2026-10-20, テスラSI, pool created 2026-10-19 02:34 UTC, whose Japanese metadata says Musk announced SpaceXAI becomes SpaceXSI and describes a 3% trade tax with 30% paid as on-chain dividends to holders). The Tetsuo Super Intelligence coin on pump.fun (TSI, Solana) joined on 2026-10-18 with a pool 4.6 hours old at discovery: traders' posts call TSI "another SI coin" and one says Elon Musk posted about it (e1:2), which is unverified. Its Clanker twin on Robinhood Chain left on 2026-10-20 after 24h pool volume of $277 and then $0. SPACEXSI and Ollie (pump.fun) left on 2026-10-17, and SIGF (pump.fun) and SuperHooks (Pons) on 2026-10-18, after their 24h pool volume stayed under $1,000. None is shown to be affiliated with the announcements. SpaceXSITeslaBoringaLink (SXSITBL, pump.fun) joined on 2026-10-19: its name combines SpaceXSI with Tesla and Boring, its pool was created on 2026-10-19 at 03:47 UTC, and nothing seen ties it to the announcements. Smaller coins named for SpaceXSI or TSI under the $100K market cap bar are not counted. Measured: fifteen coins across all their pools.

k-fund.reason: The "dividend / fund" family is large but mostly quarantined: the American Oil Dividend Fund (AODF, four contracts), National Oil Dividend Fund (NODF), XTO (two), American Overwatch Protocol (AOP, three), UDR, USCR, UER and UDTF all carry quarantine flags (implausible market caps or extreme 24h moves) and can never be constituents.
